bullets.text: Designed a FastAPI payout service processing 1.2M transactions per day with 99.95% uptime
Cut p95 latency on the balance API from 420ms to 90ms by tuning PostgreSQL indexes and adding a Redis cache
Migrated 14 services from EC2 to Kubernetes on AWS EKS, reducing infrastructure cost by 30%
Built CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions that run 2,000 automated tests in under 6 minutes
Mentored 3 junior engineers, two of whom were promoted within a year
Built order and inventory APIs in Python and Django serving 400k monthly users
Containerised the monolith with Docker, cutting onboarding setup from two days to one hour
Introduced Terraform for RDS and S3 provisioning across three environments
Reduced failed checkout rate by 18% by adding idempotency keys to payment calls

education.requirement: BSc in Computer Science or equivalent experience

gaps.requirement: Kafka or another event streaming platform
